articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Eledon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (“Eledon”) (Nasdaq: ELDN) today announced an oral presentation will be featured at the upcoming American Society of Nephrology Kidney Week 2026 Annual Meeting taking place in Denver, CO, from October 21-25, 2026.
articles.title: Eledon Pharmaceuticals Announces Presentation at the American Society of Nephrology Kidney Week 2026 Annual Meeting
